grammar.title: Raising a level with 提高
grammar.explanation: 提高 (tígāo) means "to raise, to improve, to increase" used for abstract things like ability, level, or quality, not physical objects.

sentences.zh: 他想提高自己的汉语水平。
sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng tígāo zìjǐ de Hànyǔ shuǐpíng.
sentences.en: He wants to improve his Chinese level.
We need to raise our work standard.
Studying more can raise your level.

sentences.zh: 老师帮我们提高汉语水平。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī bāng wǒmen tígāo Hànyǔ shuǐpíng.
sentences.en: The teacher helps us improve our Chinese level.
